Package de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix

Class DenseMatrix

java.lang.Object
de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix
de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.DenseMatrix
public final class DenseMatrix extends Matrix
Dense matrix backed by a column-major double[] buffer of length rows * cols. Element (i, j) is stored at data[i + j * rows].

Column-major is the layout LAPACK and BLAS expect, so data() can be passed directly to dgesv / dgeqrf / dgesvd / dpotrf / dsyr / dsyr2 with no copy. The hot kernel mtimes(Matrix) dispatches to BLAS dgemm when both operands are DenseMatrix; everything else falls back to a triple loop.

Subclass of Matrix so existing call sites that accept a generic Matrix keep working unchanged. As the migration progresses, callers narrow their declared types to DenseMatrix where the dense specialisation matters (BLAS dgemm fast path or data() pass-through to LAPACK).

      public static DenseMatrix fromColumnMajor(int rows, int cols, double[] data)
      Wrap an already-column-major buffer without copying. The caller surrenders ownership of data: subsequent mutations through this matrix will be visible to anyone else holding the array.
      Parameters:
      rows - number of rows
      cols - number of columns
      data - column-major buffer of length rows * cols; the entry at (i, j) is data[i + j * rows]
      Returns:
      a DenseMatrix that aliases data
